# Noviq

> Noviq turns any app's App Store or Google Play reviews into clean, structured
> data — sentiment analysis, rating trends, version history, activity heatmaps,
> and CSV/JSON export. Free, no signup required.

Paste an App Store or Google Play link on the homepage to scrape an app's
reviews and explore them in an interactive dashboard.

## Pages

- [Home](https://noviq.app/): paste a store link, scrape reviews, explore the dashboard, export CSV/JSON.

## Facts

- Supports both Apple App Store and Google Play storefronts.
- Extracts ratings, review text, developer replies, app versions, and reviewer names.
- Computes sentiment (positive/neutral/negative), rating distribution, review-volume trends, and an activity heatmap.
- Exports results as CSV or JSON.
